_comment: Single source of truth for the real-stack suite. `required`: every spec file that must exist and the exact number of tests it must PASS (update it when you add or remove a test: a silent drop in coverage must be a deliberate edit). `excluded`: things deliberately NOT in this suite, each with the reason and where they ARE covered. An excluded item is not a skipped test: this suite has no skips at all.

excluded.reason: needs no backend; the UI is identical against the fake
menus and keyboard focus, no API
pure client code with a stubbed fetch; no browser, no backend

excluded.what: admin.spec.ts, admin-authz.spec.ts, admin-catalog.spec.ts, admin-technicians.spec.ts, admin-sla-assignment.spec.ts, admin-governance.spec.ts (fake-backed admin UI specs)
excluded.reason: they assert against the in-browser fake's seeded data; the same areas are re-tested against the real backend by the specs listed under `required`
excluded.coveredBy: frontend/e2e (fake-API layer); real-backend equivalents in this suite

excluded.reason: this job raises the IP-wide limits because every test comes from one address; the per-EMAIL login limit keeps its production value and IS tested here

excluded.what: assignment strategy catalog ABSENT / FAILED states, changing assignment settings, assignment-settings optimistic lock
excluded.reason: the backend now always has P3's real catalog (AVAILABLE, which IS tested); the other states cannot occur in the real stack, and changing the shared singleton would make the specs order-dependent
excluded.coveredBy: backend suite (AssignmentSettings*, StrategyCatalogGatewayTest, ProviderFailureSemantics) and the fake-API layer (UI states)

excluded.reason: CI is plain HTTP, so the backend runs with the dev profile and AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false
